title: Skipass Madness After Christmas
summary: 2.5D downhill skiing with real slope physics on six Roccaraso pistes traced from the area map: real turns, pitches, gullies and forest.
description: An original third-person downhill skiing game on six pistes of the Roccaraso / Alto Sangro ski area in Abruzzo, traced from the official panoramic piste map and back-projected from its perspective: E1 Aremogna (Valle Verde to Piazzale Aremogna), M1 Monte Pratello (the ridge and the hook down to Prato), D4 Toppe-Aremogna (summit ridge, hairpin, the C4-D4 forest track and the gap), D1 Toppe del Tesoro (the black, with the narrow rock-walled chute to Valle Verde), T8 Pizzalto (the long diagonal face) and K2 Crete Rosse (forest S-bends to the Monte Pratello hut and the P1 valley down to Rivisondoli). Real start and finish altitudes, the map's sequence of turns and pitches, gully walls that bank you back, forest density and lift crossings sampled from the map. A drone-follow 2.5D camera renders the altitude profile in depth slices, so crests hide the slope beyond and the camera pitches with the mountain. Fixed-point physics simulates gravity along the slope, snow friction (groomed, ice, powder, moguls, snowplough, skidding), aerodynamic drag in upright and tuck, carving radius, ballistic jumps and landings. Dodge the after-Christmas crowd, ski schools, sitting snowboarders and snowcats, pass under chairlifts and past the rifugi, and reach the valley before the skipass expires. Networked consoles in the same room race as live rivals with ranking. Stereo SID-like music only on title, demo, winning and game-over screens; skiing uses stereo procedural effects (snow hiss, wind, carving scrape, landings, crashes, checkpoints).
controls: Left/Right carve; Up tuck; Down snowplough/brake; B pole push (title: MAESTRO assist on/off); A/Start select and start
